_real_world.designation: AGM-88E AARGM (Advanced Anti-Radiation Guided Missile), fielded variant (AGM-88G AARGM-ER excluded from the 2025-26 baseline, IOC planned 1QFY27)
_real_world.role: Suppression-of-enemy-air-defenses (SEAD) anti-radiation missile, EA-18G primary weapon, also carried by F/A-18E/F
_real_world.guidance_real: GPS/INS midcourse, passive anti-radiation homing (RF seeker on the emitting threat radar), active millimeter-wave (MMW) terminal seeker for terminal precision/moving or shut-down emitters
_real_world.mount_mapping: referenced by CVW-8 EA-18G/F-18E/F default_loadout as an air-to-ground/anti-radiation weapon; standard air-launched missile mechanism used, though the engine has no distinct anti-radiation-homing seeker category

mass_kg.note: 795 lb = 361 kg per CSG order-of-battle page's NAVAIR-sourced AGM-88E row

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the sourced ~80 nmi range (C-est, not published by the Navy, per designation-systems.net via the OOB page) at the used Mach 2+ / 680 m/s speed

flight_model.max_speed.note: Mach 2+ per NAVAIR (OOB page); ~680 m/s at altitude used as the engineering-estimate numeric conversion since Mach varies with altitude/temperature

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; engineering estimate for a supersonic anti-radiation missile, below the pure air-to-air AIM-120D/AIM-9X class but above a subsonic anti-ship cruise missile

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate consistent with flight_model.max_g

guidance.type.note: GPS/INS midcourse, passive anti-radiation homing, active MMW terminal per NAVAIR (OOB page); ActiveRadar is used as the nearest matching real engine seeker_type since the engine's guidance.type vocabulary has no distinct anti-radiation-homing category

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public seeker acquisition range (classified); engineering estimate typical of an anti-radiation missile's passive RF detection range against an emitting threat radar

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode modeled for the passive-to-active MMW seeker handover in this pass

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proxy interpolated between the repo AIM-120C-7 template (4.0) and CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched (3.5) patterns; no public guidance-law constant

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: proxy interpolated between the same two repo templates; no public figure

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: proxy interpolated between the same two repo templates; no public figure

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: proxy consistent with flight_model.max_g, interpolated between the AIM-120C-7 template and a slower anti-ship cruise missile pattern

warhead.type.note: blast-fragmentation warhead, standard for the HARM/AARGM WDU-21/B-family lineage; not explicitly re-stated by NAVAIR on the OOB page's AARGM row but consistent with the AGM-88 family's publicly known warhead type

warhead.mass_kg.note: no public AGM-88E-specific warhead mass; engineering estimate derived as ~18% of the sourced 361 kg all-up mass, consistent with the legacy HARM family's publicly reported ~66 kg (145 lb) WDU-21/B warhead

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate, no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of warhead.mass_kg, no public split figure

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied/interpolated from the repo AIM-120C-7 and CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched projection-geometry patterns

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: scaled from this warhead's lethal_radius, same pattern as other CSG missile records

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: copied from the repo AIM-120C-7 template pattern

fuze.type.note: no public fuze timing data; radar_proximity is the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family, consistent with the active MMW terminal seeker's proximity-detonation role

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: set equal to warhead.lethal_radius per the repo AIM-120C-7 template's fuze-trigger-radius convention; no public standoff distance

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold interpolated between repo templates

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold value consistent with a mature fielded (not developmental) AGM-88E variant

modeling_notes: Functional mount via standard air-launched missile mechanism (though the engine's guidance.type vocabulary has no distinct anti-radiation-homing seeker category, approximated as ActiveRadar). AGM-88G AARGM-ER excluded per DOT&E FY25 (OOB page): IOC planned 1QFY27, IT events delayed in FY25, not part of the 2025-26 baseline, and not modeled as a separate record in this packet.
